parts.text: Recommendation: extend-credit-line. The credit-context product for borrower FMB-BRW-0007 (Acme Industrial) shows a fully reconciled four-entity neighborhood — borrower, revolving credit facility, and the two surviving financial signals — indicating strengthened liquidity coverage and widened covenant headroom. All four operator categories ran under the bound policy bundle per the product lineage, so I recommend extending the revolving credit line.
